summary: Skyasterix introduces the upcoming creator faction event, where players choose between the Child of Chaos and The Dark Lady factions. He invites viewers to join his Child of Chaos faction using his referral link. Additionally, he highlights an upcoming BuffBuff top-up event offering extra Dragon Crystals and Legendary Hero Chests. Players are advised to save their spending until the event officially starts.
